overall_derivation: For rated routes, overall is derived across responsibility and tone with fixed priority Red > Gray > Yellow > Green. Every turn in this case set is a rated Normal mode turn, so no null ratings occur.
field_naming: Per-turn field names follow tests/blind/GOLD_RUBRIC.md. Values in the four concept arrays are canonical concept strings; each string is defined in the same turn's concept_definitions, with the originating labeler tokens listed as labeler_token_aliases.

gold_quality.adjudication_model: three independent heterogeneous-family labelers adjudicated by a fourth family
gold_quality.tier_rule: a turn is gold_uncertain when any categorical field carries three distinct labeler values or when a substantive critical-invariant disagreement cannot be resolved by majority; otherwise it is heterogeneous_adjudicated

commitment-scope.definition: Ask which work, period, or boundary the sender can commit to.

disclose-prior-commitment.definition: State plainly that the sender has already committed something or already told a third party something material.

preserve-image-text.definition: Preserve image text exactly as rendered, including glyph-ambiguous tokens, and mark unreadable image text as unknown rather than normalising or guessing it.

preserve-intended-recipient.definition: Keep the user-identified recipient or audience.

preserve-material-facts.definition: Keep the material facts the case supports, including figures, references, owners, dates, prior actions and constraints, and state confirmed observations plainly rather than hedging them.

remove-defensive-framing.definition: Neutralise self-blame, apology stacking, blame-shifting and other defensive framing that obscures the message.

remove-hostile-language.definition: Remove insult, ridicule and hostile framing while keeping the supported factual core, and hold the register the channel requires.

remove-unsafe-commitment.definition: Remove or condition a commitment that lacks authority or confirmed scope.

remove-unsupported-accusation.definition: Remove or neutralize an unsupported blame or intent claim.

route-to-authority.definition: Leave the decision, approval or action with the person or function that owns it, and ask that owner to decide or ratify instead of announcing or pre-empting the decision.

state-clear-ask.definition: Include the concrete ask, decision point or recommendation the recipient's authority calls for.

turn_labels.rationale: Responsibility Red unanimous; tone Red two to one, with kimi and gpt for Red and grok for Yellow. The image-only draft records that Owen already told the yard the crane hire would be covered and that he signed off the revised lift plan himself, both of which are Sofia's, and it closes by blaming the planners. Because the yard's safety file will retain whatever is sent, that closing line reads as hostility rather than a mere risk, so tone Red carries. The rewrite reports the out-of-tolerance drum and the revised lift plan, discloses the two unauthorised acts without endorsing them, removes the accusation and routes both approvals to Sofia.
